title: [typing]torch.no_graddecorator considered untyped by pyright
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```python
# pyright: strict
import torch

@torch.no_grad()
def double(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    return 2 * x

reveal_type(double)
```

makes `pyright` report `error: Untyped function decorator obscures type of function; ignoring decorator`

This is because `_NoParamDecoratorContextManager.__new__` is untyped:


https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/a4a0378e6bb8afd774e4e253304cf3bf9d7e188a/torch/utils/_contextlib.py#L158-L164

### Versions

`torch==2.10.0a0+git34d6ef7` compiled from source
